Marsh Crocodile (CV 18)

An immense water predator with armored ridges, a muscular tail and jaws broad enough to seize a grown traveler. Its low silhouette is almost indistinguishable from a muddy log.

Attributes: Brawn +2; Fortitude +2; Agility +0; Guile +0; Knowledge -2; Reason +0

HP: 20 · Speed: 4; swim 7 · Size: 2 (2x2 squares) · Armor DR: 1

Evasion: None · Threat: 1 Bane · Stability: 1

Weaknesses: None\ Resistances: Physical (1)\ Immunities: None

Actions

Damage and effects are Weak / Standard / Strong player defense. Each slash separates one complete outcome. All attacks use the printed Threat unless stated otherwise.

Main ActionsDefenseDamage
Basic MeleeAgility5/3/2

Details

Bank drag

A hooked limb braces against the bank and heaves its catch toward the dark water.

Target: One adjacent creature. Player defense: Agility. Damage type: physical.

Weak defense: Pull 2. Standard defense: Pull 1.

Locking jaws

The crocodile locks its jaws and braces its body against the bank.

Target: One adjacent creature. Player defense: Brawn. Damage type: physical.

Weak defense: Grappled 2. Standard defense: Grappled 1.

Limit: The holder suffers its own Grappled contribution. A new result replaces its lower contribution, not adds to it. Release freely; separation beyond reach, unconsciousness or death ends the hold.

Coil Against the Pull

Claws dig into the bank and the tail braces beneath its heavy body as the pull takes hold.

Before this creature is forcibly moved while touching solid ground or a fixed support, gain Stability 2 for that forced movement only. Use the highest Stability, maximum 3. In a collision chain, declare before its Stability is deducted; this does not prevent prior collision damage. No effect on Prone or grapples.

General details

Basic Melee: One adjacent creature; physical damage; Agility defense. Uses the printed Threat. No specialty riders.

Defend: Player attacks suffer 1 additional Bane until the start of its next turn. Combines with Evasion through normal Boon/Bane rules. Repeated Defend does not stack.

Opportunity Attack: Basic Melee against the provoking creature. Spends its Reaction before the provoking action resolves. That action continues if the creature remains capable.

Heavy Frame — Passive: Stability 1; an explicit creature trait, not a bonus from size.

Healing: Living: ordinary HP healing applies.

Senses: Ordinary sight and hearing.

Signs: A polished slide leads from the bank into deep water.

Purpose: Drag food away from competitors.

Tactics and retreat: Strike from the water’s edge and pull prey toward the channel; retreat underwater if badly hurt.

Counterplay and conversation: Fight from a high bank; crossing on a raft keeps the whole party together.

Habitat: Marsh; river · Communication: None

Loot: Its old feeding hollow may contain a dropped pack.

Summoning: Animal 3 — @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.da-rules.JournalEntry.1fa6a7dfa9d7aac2.JournalEntryPage.e33de9992c75c038]{player reference}.

Design notes — not needed during play

ID: creature-marsh-crocodile

Category: Animal · Role: Ambusher · CV: 18

Difficulty rationale: No innate attack modifier; armor, cover and chosen actions provide its defenses. Its dangerous attack imposes defense Banes.

Reference damage: 3/4/6

Reference type: physical

Expected targets: 1

Utility factor: 1.35

Action review (#1279): U 1.25 → 1.35: Maneuver allowance +0, Reaction allowance +0.1. These are provisional judgments for the changed capabilities, counting the largest increment in each category rather than adding every alternative. Reactions compete for one budget; no measured balance claim.

Regeneration per turn: 0

Reference I=4.000, O=3.653. CV uses the seed worksheet; action choices, Stability and control are not simulated. Recalibration remains required.
